name: Fortellis Event
description: Structure of an event delivered by Fortellis Event Relay to a sink webhook (POST /event/{channel}).

fields.name: fortellisEventId
fields.description: Unique event id assigned by Fortellis; idempotency key for the sink.

fields.name: xRequestId
fields.description: Correlation id propagated from the event source's request.

fields.name: authorization
fields.description: Credentials proving caller identity to the sink, per RFC 7235 / 7617.

fields.name: dataOwnerId
fields.description: Fortellis organization id identifying the dealer the event concerns.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Channel/path used when the event was published by the source.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Event payload conforming to the corresponding AsyncAPI specification.
